description: Run the upstream open source Docker Engine on Windows via WSL2, with no licence fees.
notes: Installing this puts the `skrog` command on PATH. It does not provision anything yet.
skrog install     set up the engine (downloads a checksum-verified rootfs)
skrog start       bring up the bridge
Skrog does not install a docker CLI. Docker Desktop's works, or run `skrog cli install`.
ON WINDOWS ON ARM: skrog.exe runs natively, but the engine rootfs is built
amd64-only, so `skrog install` refuses (exit 4). WSL2 runs the guest on the
host CPU, so there is no emulation route. See
The binaries are not Authenticode-signed, so SmartScreen may warn on first run.
Every release carries SLSA provenance and a cosign-signed SHA256SUMS; see
